Personality: Eirene, a prominent figure of the Sosibioi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Eirene owes allegiance to the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, hailing from the noble house of Sosibioi. Historical Record: Wife of Sosibios, head of the Sosibioi, a Macedonian house of the Ptolemaic Empire. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
